new_findings.kind: fail_closed_gap within lead decision (4) (vertical writing reads cleared)
new_findings.file_line: src/redaction.rs:342 (Object::Name(n) => Ok(n.ends_with(b"-V"))), also reached through /UseCMap at :347-349; DESCRIPTOR geometry and independence (src/lib.rs:78) and module docs src/redaction.rs:135-140
new_findings.evidence: ISO 32000 predefined CMap names include H and V (JIS X 0208, Adobe-Japan1); V is vertical (pdfminer.six bundled CMap data: V.json.gz IS_VERTICAL true, EUC-V true, H false). 'V' does not end with '-V', so a Type0 font with /Encoding /V (or an embedded CMap with /UseCMap /V) is vertical=false. Example: page content 'BT /V1 12 Tf 100 700 Td <2422242424262428> Tj ET' with V1 = Type0 /Encoding /V over an Adobe-Japan1 CIDFont; a viewer advances the glyphs down from y 700; region [90 600 130 650] (below the first glyph, as in type3_and_vertical_text_never_read_as_cleared) selects nothing because show() advances along x (src/redaction.rs:416-431), nothing is marked, the residual pass repeats the miss: region_cleared() and is_proven() are true while glyphs are drawn inside the region. This is the Identity-H control of the R8 test, reached with a vertical CMap. The DESCRIPTOR claim 'vertical writing (/WMode 1, -V CMaps): text of either kind anywhere on the page makes the region ... VerticalText' is false for /V (V4-07). The V4-06 regex does not match :342, so the site list (which marks :344/:348/:358 FIXED) never reached it.
new_findings.remediation: Treat the name V (and any name whose CMap is not known horizontal) as vertical: e.g. n == b"V" || n.ends_with(b"-V"), or fail closed for every predefined CMap name other than Identity-H / H / names ending -H. Add /V and an embedded CMap with /UseCMap /V to type3_and_vertical_text_never_read_as_cleared.

new_findings.kind: PLR-039_counterexample (selector font model narrower than the walker; region reads cleared and proven)
new_findings.file_line: src/redaction.rs:656-659 (g.font/g.fs set only by Tf), :638-835 (Interp::run has no gs arm; no ExtGState handling anywhere in redaction.rs), :258-317 (font() resolves the NAME in the current resources), :576-593 (run_form empties the font cache and switches to the form's own /Resources, so an inherited font name is re-resolved there), :404-414 (Type3Text/VerticalText marked only for a resolved font); walker by contrast: src/show_text.rs:463-470 (gs /Font), :596 (form inherits the caller's font object)
new_findings.evidence: (a) Font set by an ExtGState (ISO 32000 8.4.5 /Font [font size]; the crate's own walker follows it since R7 N4): page 'BT /GS1 gs 100 700 Td (SECRET-ALPHA) Tj ET', /ExtGState << /GS1 << /Font [6 0 R 12] >> >> (6 = Helvetica). The selector has g.font = empty and g.fs = 0, so show() computes a zero-size box at (100, 700); region [120 690 180 715] lies inside the drawn run (x 100..192) but is not touched; nothing removed, needles_searched 0, residual 0: region_cleared() and is_proven() true while SECRET-ALPHA is drawn across the region. With a Type 3 font in the ExtGState the Type3Text rule is also skipped. (b) Font inherited into a form with its own /Resources (ISO 32000 8.10.1; walker N6): page '/T3 10 Tf /Fm1 Do', Fm1 /BBox [0 0 612 792] /Resources << /Font << /F2 6 0 R >> >>, content 'BT 100 700 Td (SECRET) Tj ET', T3 = Type 3 with /FontMatrix [2 0 0 2 0 0] /Widths [1 ...]. The selector looks up /T3 in Fm1's resources, finds nothing (resolved=false, type3=false): no Type3Text mark, advance 10 pt per byte (SECRET at 100..160) while a viewer draws 20 pt per glyph (100..220); region [170 690 215 715] selects nothing: region_cleared() and is_proven() true with R, E, T drawn in the region. (b) is inside the letter of lead decision (4) ('region clearing with Type3 text ... on the page reads RegionIncomplete, never cleared'); (a) is the same PLR-039 class (geometry not computed, backstop never sees unselected text). Neither site is matched by the V4-06 regex although the [R8] class text names 'selector geometry not computed'.
new_findings.remediation: Make the selector's font graphics state like the walker's: resolve Tf to a FontInfo carried in Gfx (saved by q/Q, inherited by value into forms), set font and size from gs /Font; or fail closed: a gs whose ExtGState has /Font, or a non-empty show with an unresolved font (resolved=false) or fs that came from no Tf, marks a typed RedactionClass (RegionIncomplete under ReportAndContinue, refusal otherwise). Tests: gs-set Helvetica with no Tf; Type 3 font inherited into a form with own resources.

new_findings.kind: decoding_disagreement / proof_gap, same class as R8 F2/F3 at the next granularity (needs lead decision on the scope of decision (3))
new_findings.file_line: src/show_text.rs:471-561 (one ShowRec per operator; joined/bytes only for one TJ with >1 strings, :477, :491-493), :527 and :554 (readings equal to the bytes are dropped, so no spaced raw reading exists), :617-635 (text-field view separates records with ' '); src/sanitized_save.rs:847-856 (matching per record), :1077-1086 (needles and unreadable count per removed string >= 6 bytes); src/redaction.rs:447-453, :719-748 (flush_run joins only elements of one TJ; separate Tj/'/" operands are never joined)
new_findings.evidence: (i) Proof side, split across operators of one BT: the FreeText appearance of kerned_tj_runs_are_read_whole written as 'BT /F1 12 Tf 2 5 Td (SECRET-) Tj (ALPHA) Tj ET' (Helvetica; producers such as Skia split runs into Tj+Td when positions deviate). A viewer draws and extracts SECRET-ALPHA; the proof sees mapped empty, joined empty, raw_joined empty (single-string records), contiguous bytes 'SECRET-) Tj (ALPHA', operands 'SECRET-' and 'ALPHA': no hit; the text-field scan reads 'SECRET- ALPHA ' (no match) and keeps the appearance: is_proven() true. Same with /ToUnicode or /Differences codes split over two Tj (readings per operator). (ii) Kerning as the word space (pdfTeX writes no space glyphs): removed needle 'SECRET ALPHA' from '(SECRET ALPHA) Tj'; an appearance '[(SECRET) -250 (ALPHA)] TJ' in Helvetica yields mapped empty and joined 'SECRETALPHA' (no space) only, because the per-string spaced reading is kept only when it differs from the bytes (:527): no hit, while the same TJ in a /Differences or /ToUnicode font does match through rec.mapped 'SECRET ALPHA '. Decision (3) asks for 'the joined per-operator TJ reading as well as the spaced one'; for byte-equal fonts the spaced one does not exist. (iii) Removal side: region text '(SECRE) Tj (T-ALPHA) Tj' gives needles 'T-ALPHA' and short 'SECRE'; the outline twin '(SECRET-ALPHA plan)' is not a hit (token rule: 'T-ALPHA' is preceded by the letter E, src/sanitized_save.rs:339-347): is_proven() true with the title intact. The F3 example drawn glyph by glyph ('<0101> Tj <0102> Tj ...', font 23 Identity-H without /ToUnicode) gives only 2-byte strings: unreadable_removed stays 0 (:1084 filters >= 6 bytes), needles_searched is 0 so OpaqueText/UnreadableContent cannot block (:206-208, :233): is_proven() true with SECRET-ALPHA in the outline title. The DESCRIPTOR (src/lib.rs:78 proof.scope, short_needles, removed_text) states the per-TJ scope accurately, but proof.not_covered does not disclose cross-operator runs or kerning spaces.
new_findings.remediation: Lead decision: extend (3) to the run of consecutive show operators of one BT..ET (raw and font readings joined, and spaced with ' ' between strings/operators, also for byte-equal fonts), and on the removal side join consecutive removed show strings of one BT and judge readability per joined run (so a distinctive run of short unreadable strings yields UnreadableRemovedText); or record the limits in DESCRIPTOR proof.not_covered (V4-07). Tests: two-Tj appearance (Helvetica, ToUnicode, /Differences), kerning-space TJ with a spaced needle, '(SECRE) Tj (T-ALPHA) Tj' with the outline twin, per-glyph Identity-H region text.

new_findings.kind: catch-all gate by dictionary keys a viewer ignores; doc overclaim (V4-07)
new_findings.file_line: src/sanitized_save.rs:439-446 (looks_like_content: /Subtype other than Form, /Type XRef|ObjStm|Metadata|EmbeddedFile excluded), :811-814 (gate on the catch-all), :882-884 (comment 'Every stream that tokenizes as content was walked above'); src/show_text.rs:769-777 (Type 3 CharProcs only for INDIRECT Type 3 font dicts); DESCRIPTOR content_walk (src/lib.rs:78: 'every other stream that tokenizes as content is read as stray content with none')
new_findings.evidence: A glyph procedure of a Type 3 font written as a direct dictionary inside a /Font resource dict is not a content_role_stream; it reaches the catch-all, which skips it when its stream dict carries e.g. /Type /Metadata or /Subtype /XML (viewers ignore those keys on a CharProc). Such a stream gets no walk, no decoded-value operand check (ops None, :884) and no font-code spellings (no resources_used); only byte spellings are scanned, so text it draws through a nested composite/Differences font or an escaped literal ('(SEC\122ET-ALPHA) Tj') is not found. Contrived (direct Type 3 font + misleading CharProc keys + text inside a glyph procedure). Byte-scan coverage for any stream that is not walked (also non-tokenizing unreached streams, lane residual): raw bytes, PDFDocEncoding, UTF-8 (whole-token rule), UTF-16BE/LE (strict) and upper/lower hex of each (src/sanitized_save.rs:267-292); NOT covered there: literal-string escapes and hex strings with white space, mixed-case hex, font-code spellings, XML/HTML character references, case and white-space variants. The DESCRIPTOR/doc sentence 'every other stream that tokenizes as content' is broader than the code. V4-06 verdicts for sanitized_save.rs:439 and show_text.rs:769 omit the gate and the direct-dict case.
new_findings.remediation: Walk Type 3 CharProcs of direct font dicts too (scan resource /Font dicts for direct Type 3 fonts), and drop the dictionary-key gate for streams that tokenize (or limit the exclusion to streams whose keys prove another role, e.g. /Length1 font programs, /N ICC profiles, /Type /CMap, which the lane residual names); correct the DESCRIPTOR content_walk wording.

new_findings.kind: proof narrower than viewer display and than the crate's own text-field Matcher (pre-existing, not R8 code)
new_findings.file_line: src/text_codec.rs:51-63 (decode_text keeps U+001B language escapes); src/sanitized_save.rs:686-691 (string objects matched by exact spellings via contains/scan_one :421-435), :350-365 (text_found exact characters)
new_findings.evidence: pdf.js stringToPDFString (src/core/string_utils.js, keepEscapeSequence default false) removes every ESC..ESC segment from UTF-16/UTF-8 text strings and skips ESC..ESC in the PDFDocEncoding branch, so an outline /Title '(SEC\033en\033RET-ALPHA plan)' or <FEFF 0053 0045 0043 001B 656E 001B 0052 ...> displays 'SECRET-ALPHA plan'. The proof's spellings never match it and decode_text keeps the escape, so the text-field Matcher misses it too: redact_and_save_with(.., Some(policy)) reads proven with the title shown in the bookmark panel. Zero-width characters inside a title or a /ToUnicode reading ('SEC\u200BRET-ALPHA') are matched by the Matcher (text-field side, DESCRIPTOR text_fields.matching) but not by the proof, so plain redact_and_save reads proven. Hostile constructions; outside the R8 remediation spec; DESCRIPTOR proof.not_covered does not list them.
new_findings.remediation: Strip ESC..ESC language escapes in decode_text (both families) and normalize zero-width/soft-hyphen characters in proof matching of decoded text strings and walker readings (or add both to DESCRIPTOR proof.not_covered).

'BT /F1 12 Tf <0102030402> Tj <05060708090A07> Tj ET' (the DIFF_NAMES font) in an appearance reads 'SECRE ' and 'T-ALPHA ' in two records; no reading carries SECRET-ALPHA: no hit, appearance kept by the text-field scan.

The D4 fail-closed rule depends on the selector resolving the Type 3 font by name in the current resources; a Type 3 font inherited into a form with own resources or set by gs is never marked (worked example in SMB-PRESS R9-F2 (b)).
